name: dsh-copilot-acp
description: GitHub Copilot (the official Copilot CLI) as an ACP subagent for DeepSeek Harness: install it, sign in once, and the agent can delegate work to Copilot.
comment: No peerDependencies, deliberately. Two reasons: (1) this plugin imports nothing but Node builtins at module scope and resolves every harness package lazily inside apply(), so it needs no peer to be present at load time; (2) declaring peers makes pnpm install extra copies of shared harness packages into the profile, and a copy installed at the profile root shadows the installation's version under Node's nearest-node_modules rule. That is exactly how this package once broke DSH's boot: an auto-installed @deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials@0.1.0-rc.8 shadowed the installation's 0.1.2-rc.1, whose `credentialKey` export the plugin imported at module scope. Keep it peer-free.

The two @deepseek-ai backends are pinned exactly: a mismatched harness line fails their peer ranges (npm 'latest' for dsh-subagent-acp is 0.0.1-rc.1, incompatible with a 0.1.2-rc.1 harness). Bump both when the harness moves.
